transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Honestly, I’ve been feeling absolutely on top of the world with this incredible, unstoppable energy for the last seven months! I’m constantly on the move and starting so many new projects because I just feel so alive and active. My family insisted I come in to get checked out, but I've honestly never felt better!
During these past seven months, have you had hallucinations or strong unusual beliefs, and if so, did they ever continue for at least two weeks when your mood was not especially high or energized?

Yes, I've definitely had some very unusual beliefs and even heard and seen things over these past seven months. However, those experiences only ever happen when I am feeling incredibly high, energetic, and active. They have never occurred during times when my mood was normal or when I wasn't energized.
Have there been times during this high-energy period when your symptoms became so severe that you needed to be hospitalized or were unable to function safely because of them?

No, I've never been hospitalized, and I don't think I've ever been completely unable to function safely. I've just been feeling this incredible, intense high energy and confidence constantly for the past seven months.
